responsibility: Declares the RISC-V entry points used by the D front end and binds them to the D target-hook macros. It is the small interface header that exposes the implementations in riscv-d.cc for target-version emission and target-info registration, rather than containing ABI logic itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the tiny interface header for the RISC-V D hooks, declaring `riscv_d_target_versions` and `riscv_d_register_target_info` and mapping them onto `TARGET_D_*` macros. Unlike `riscv-d.cc`, it does not derive ABI information itself or implement any D target-info handlers.
